title: Totem Rework
description: Totems now save your inventory after dying instead of giving you a second chance
body:
**Totem Rework** is a lightweight plugin that redefines the Totem of Undying. Instead of saving players from death, the totem now acts as a one-time inventory backup. Upon death, the player's inventory and armor are safely restored — no more running back to death spots or losing gear to lava. The totems do not save experience tho.

Perfect for hardcore servers, RPG worlds, or custom game modes where survival is brutal but progress shouldn't be lost to a single mistake.
